# hivelocity_order (Data Source)

Returns the status of one order by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_order" "web" {
  order_id = hivelocity_bare_metal_device.web.order_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `order_id` (Number) ID of the order.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `info` (Map of String) Additional order information as reported by the API.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the order.
- `status` (String) Order status, for example `complete`.
- `total` (Number) Order total.
